about_the_game:
You're just a guy who loves fighting and martial arts. You trained hard and earned yourself quite a reputation, winning one competition after another. Bored with your college routine and the lack of challenging opponents, you decide to enter an underground fighting tournament. What will be your surprise when it turns out that you will be facing a female opponent…

Losing to her could change your life forever. Not only would it shatter your confidence as a fighter, but it might also provoke an unwanted (or wanted) reaction from the girls around you. They once respected you, but now they might see you as a sick pervert who enjoys being dominated and bullied by them.

Have you ever thought, “Damn! I want that chick to crush my skull between her thighs!” ?

Well, then...

UnderGirl is a femdom-centric game in which you will have to fight beautiful girls in order to get your pride back to where it belongs! It has a simple fighting system with five directions to block. Look at your opponent and try to guess which attack they are going to use and then intercept it! Be careful though, they won't hesitate to use all the dirty tricks at their disposal to make you squirm.

Keep in mind, if you make some very bad choices, the fight can end worse than just a small loss to your record. Remember, in the underground fighting community, there are no rules or guidelines to follow. It might be over for you before you even realize what hit you.

SIDE CHARACTERS

Itaiero

Fuyumi, Kado, Denki

ATTENTION: ALL CHARACTERS IN THIS GAME ARE OVER THE AGE OF 20!!!

As a femdom 2D Visual Novel with Action elements, UnderGirl: SP features:

  • Complete storyline with 4 battles against beautiful girls!

  • Secret Dates Mode with more intimate scenes...

  • Over than 30 unique losing scenes!

  • Flashy and dynamic hand-made graphics!

  • Fully voiced fights in English (Japanese coming soon)!

  • Convenient replay and gallery menus!

content_descriptors.notes: In this game you might get beaten up, choked out, smothered, stepped on, neck snapped, humiliated, etc. by beautiful, curvy girls! However, whether they do all that or not depends entirely on your choices! Proceed with caution ;)
